rows.written_definition: noncomputable def height : ℝ := 3000000000000
noncomputable def sourceM0 : ℝ := sqrt (1+(2/3)*sqrt (6/5))
noncomputable def vertical (σ t : ℝ) : ℂ := (σ:ℂ)+(t:ℂ)*Complex.I

noncomputable def mollifier (X : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊X⌋₊, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n:ℂ)*(n:ℂ)^(-s)

noncomputable def mollifiedError (X : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  riemannZeta s*mollifier X s-1

noncomputable def cumulativeSquare (X σ t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..t, ‖mollifiedError X (vertical σ u)‖^2
noncomputable def scaledCriticalF (T x : ℝ) : ℝ := cumulativeSquare T (1/2) (x*T)

noncomputable def smoothingWeight (T : ℝ) (s : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ((s-1)/s)*Complex.exp (((601/5000:ℝ):ℂ)*(s/(T:ℂ))^2)

noncomputable def sourceMoment (T σ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ t : ℝ, ‖smoothingWeight T (vertical σ t)*mollifiedError T (vertical σ t)‖^2
noncomputable def gaussianWeight (x : ℝ) : ℝ := x*exp (-(601/2500:ℝ)*x^2)
noncomputable def meanOne (T : ℝ) : ℝ := 6/Real.pi^2+(131/125)/log T

noncomputable def meanTwo (T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi*sourceM0*(31/50)/log T+6*sourceM0/(Real.pi*T)+
    Real.pi*sourceM0*(131/125)/(T*log T)

noncomputable def rightFive (gamma delta T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi*sourceM0*(529/1000)/(2*delta)*
    (1+2*delta/log T)^2*exp (2*delta*gamma/log T)

noncomputable def rightSixExact (gamma delta T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (529/1000)/(5*delta*exp delta)*(1+delta/log T)^2*
    exp (delta*(gamma-log 5)/log T)+(121/200)*exp (-2*delta)/(log T)^2

noncomputable def rightVExact (gamma delta T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  8*(601/5000)*exp (2*(601/5000)*((1+delta/log T)/T)^2)*
    ((rightFive gamma delta T+rightSixExact gamma delta T*Real.pi*sourceM0/T)/(4*(601/5000))+
      rightSixExact gamma delta T*sqrt Real.pi/(8*(601/5000)*sqrt (2*(601/5000))))
noncomputable def alpha : ℝ := 601/5000
noncomputable def Hstar : ℝ := height-1
noncomputable def shifted (d sigma T : ℝ) : ℝ := sigma-d/log T
noncomputable def rightLine (delta T : ℝ) : ℝ := 1+delta/log T

noncomputable def sourceOmega (d sigma T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1-1/Hstar)*exp (alpha*((shifted d sigma T)/T)^2-alpha)

noncomputable def sourceFdiff (d sigma T : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  cumulativeSquare T (shifted d sigma T) T-cumulativeSquare T (shifted d sigma T) Hstar

noncomputable def rawRectangleBound (X sigma sigmap mu C7 C8 T h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((T-h)*log (1+(cumulativeSquare X sigmap T-cumulativeSquare X sigmap h)/(T-h))+
    (C7*(mu-sigmap)+C8/2)*log T)/(2*Real.pi*(sigma-sigmap))

 theorem raw_lower_continuous {X sigma sigmap mu C7 C8 T h : ℝ}
    (hs : sigmap≠1) (hh : h<T) :
    ContinuousAt (rawRectangleBound X sigma sigmap mu C7 C8 T) h := by
  have hden : T-h≠0 := (sub_pos.mpr hh).ne'
  have hc := (actual_F_endpoint_continuous hs X).continuousAt (x:=h)
  have hn := actual_F_difference_nonneg hs X hh.le
  have harg : 0<1+(cumulativeSquare X sigmap T-cumulativeSquare X sigmap h)/(T-h) := by positivity
  unfold rawRectangleBound
  have hfrac : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ =>
      1+(cumulativeSquare X sigmap T-cumulativeSquare X sigmap u)/(T-u)) h := by
    exact continuousAt_const.add ((continuousAt_const.sub hc).div (continuousAt_const.sub continuousAt_id) hden)
  have hlogcont : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ =>
      log (1+(cumulativeSquare X sigmap T-cumulativeSquare X sigmap u)/(T-u))) h :=
    hfrac.log harg.ne'
  exact (((continuousAt_const.sub continuousAt_id).mul hlogcont).add continuousAt_const).div_const _

 theorem raw_C7_mono {X sigma sigmap mu C7 C7' C8 T h : ℝ}
    (hgap : sigmap<sigma) (hmu : sigmap≤mu) (hT : 1≤T) (hC : C7≤C7') :
    rawRectangleBound X sigma sigmap mu C7 C8 T h≤rawRectangleBound X sigma sigmap mu C7' C8 T h := by
  have hl : 0≤log T := log_nonneg hT
  have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (sub_nonneg.mpr hmu)
  have hplus : C7*(mu-sigmap)+C8/2≤C7'*(mu-sigmap)+C8/2 := by linarith
  have hlogs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hplus hl
  unfold rawRectangleBound
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity : 0≤2*Real.pi*(sigma-sigmap))
  linarith

 theorem actual_low_count_zero (hRH : IEANTN.RiemannHypothesisUpTo height)
    {sigma h : ℝ} (hs : (3/4:ℝ)≤sigma) (hh : h≤height) : IEANTN.zetaN' sigma h=0 := by
  have he : IsEmpty (IEANTN.zetaZeroesIn (Ioo sigma 1) (Ioo 0 h)) := by
    refine ⟨fun z => ?_⟩
    apply hRH.false
    exact ⟨z,⟨⟨by linarith [z.property.1.1],z.property.1.2⟩,
      ⟨z.property.2.1.1.le,z.property.2.1.2.le.trans hh⟩,z.property.2.2⟩⟩
  letI := he
  simp [IEANTN.zetaN',IEANTN.zetaZeroesSum]

noncomputable def sourceBSix (X q gamma : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (1+q)*log X/(q*exp (q*log X))*
    (1+1/(q*log X)+gamma/log X+7*q/(12*(1+q)*X*log X))

 theorem bSix_semantics (x q : Expr) : value (bSix x q)=sourceBSix (value x) (value q) 1 := by
  simp [bSix,sourceBSix]
noncomputable def boundaryEta : ℝ := 507/2000
noncomputable def boundaryMu : ℝ := 1237/1000

noncomputable def sourceBFive : ℝ :=
  positiveZeta (1+boundaryEta)^4/positiveZeta (2+2*boundaryEta)^2+
  2*positiveZeta (1+boundaryEta)^2/positiveZeta (2+2*boundaryEta)

noncomputable def sourceBSeven : ℝ :=
  (1+2/((1503/500)*positiveZeta (1+boundaryEta)*height^(1+boundaryEta)))*
    ((1503/500)*positiveZeta (1+boundaryEta))^2

noncomputable def sourceBEight : ℝ :=
  sqrt ((2+boundaryEta)^2/(height-1)^2+((1+2*boundaryEta)/(height-1)+1)^2)

noncomputable def sourceBNine (gamma : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi/log 2*(log sourceBSeven+log sourceBFive-
    2*log (1-sourceBSix 1000000000 boundaryEta gamma^2))+Real.pi+
    2*(1+2*boundaryEta)/log 2*log (sourceBEight/(2*Real.pi))

noncomputable def sourceCSeven (gamma : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2*(1+2*boundaryEta)+2*Real.pi*(1+boundaryEta))/log 2+sourceBNine gamma/log height

noncomputable def sourceBEleven (tau : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1+3/((tau-1)*log height)+6/((tau-1)*log height)^2+6/((tau-1)*log height)^3

noncomputable def sourceCEightBase : ℝ :=
  (log height)^2/exp ((2*boundaryMu-2)*log height)*
    (4*boundaryMu*sourceBEleven (2*boundaryMu)/(2*boundaryMu-1)+
     2*Real.pi*sourceM0*(2*boundaryMu-1)*sourceBEleven (2*boundaryMu-1)/(boundaryMu-1))

noncomputable def sourceBTen (gamma : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -log (1-(sourceBSix height (boundaryMu-1) gamma)^2)/(sourceBSix height (boundaryMu-1) gamma)^2

noncomputable def sourceCEight (gamma : ℝ) : ℝ := sourceBTen gamma*sourceCEightBase

 theorem bEleven_semantics (tau : Expr) : value (bEleven tau)=sourceBEleven (value tau) := by
  simp [bEleven,sourceBEleven,log_semantics]
  ring

 theorem ceight_simple_semantics : value cEightSimple=2*sourceCEightBase := by
  simp [cEightSimple,sourceCEightBase,bEleven_semantics,boundaryMu,mu,
    mzero_semantics,log_semantics]
  ring

 theorem ceight_base_nonneg : 0≤sourceCEightBase := by
  have hh : 0<log height := by linarith [source_log_lower]
  have hm:=source_mzero_pos
  unfold sourceCEightBase sourceBEleven boundaryMu
  positivity

 theorem bten_le_two {gamma : ℝ} (hg0 : 0≤gamma) (hg1 : gamma≤1) : sourceBTen gamma≤2 := by
  have hH : 1<height := by norm_num [height]
  have hq : 0<boundaryMu-1 := by norm_num [boundaryMu]
  have hb0 := bsix_pos hH hq hg0
  have hbc := bsix_gamma_le hH hq hg1
  have hupper : sourceBSix height (boundaryMu-1) 1≤1/4 := by
    norm_num [boundaryMu] at hbc ⊢
    exact mu_bsix_upper
  have hb : sourceBSix height (boundaryMu-1) gamma≤1/4 := hbc.trans hupper
  let r := (sourceBSix height (boundaryMu-1) gamma)^2
  have hr : 0<r := sq_pos_of_pos hb0
  have hr' : r≤1/16 := by dsimp [r];nlinarith
  have hu : 0<1-r := by linarith
  have hl : -log (1-r)≤1/(1-r)-1 := by
    have h := log_le_sub_one_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hu)
    simpa only [log_inv,one_div] using h
  have hf : 1/(1-r)-1≤2*r := by
    apply (sub_le_iff_le_add).mpr
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hu).mpr
    nlinarith
  unfold sourceBTen
  change -log (1-r)/r≤2
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hr).mpr
  linarith

 theorem source_ceight_upper : sourceCEight eulerMascheroniConstant≤1 := by
  have hg0 : 0≤eulerMascheroniConstant := by linarith [one_half_lt_eulerMascheroniConstant]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (bten_le_two hg0 euler_gamma_le_one) ceight_base_nonneg
  have hfinite : 2*sourceCEightBase≤1 := by rw [←ceight_simple_semantics];exact ceight_simple_upper
  exact h.trans hfinite

 theorem source_log_height_uniform {T : ℝ} (hT : height≤T) : 28≤log T := by
  exact source_log_lower.trans (log_le_log (by norm_num [height]) hT)

noncomputable def bEightAt (h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sqrt ((2+boundaryEta)^2/h^2+((1+2*boundaryEta)/h+1)^2)

noncomputable def bNineAt (gamma h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.pi/log 2*(log sourceBSeven+log sourceBFive-
    2*log (1-sourceBSix 1000000000 boundaryEta gamma^2))+Real.pi+
    2*(1+2*boundaryEta)/log 2*log (bEightAt h/(2*Real.pi))

noncomputable def cSevenAt (gamma h : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (2*(1+2*boundaryEta)+2*Real.pi*(1+boundaryEta))/log 2+bNineAt gamma h/log height
noncomputable def positiveZeta (s : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑' n : ℕ, ((n:ℝ)+1)^(-s)
def zetaZeroes : Set ℂ := {s : ℂ | riemannZeta s = 0}

def zetaZeroesIn (I J : Set ℝ) : Set ℂ :=
  {s : ℂ | s.re ∈ I ∧ s.im ∈ J ∧ s ∈ zetaZeroes}
noncomputable def zetaOrder (s : ℂ) : ℤ := (meromorphicOrderAt riemannZeta s).untopD 0

noncomputable def zetaZeroesSum {α : Type*} [RCLike α] (I J : Set ℝ) (f : ℂ → α) : α :=
  ∑' ρ : zetaZeroesIn I J, f ρ * (zetaOrder ρ : ℤ)

/-! ### Zero counting functions -/
noncomputable def zetaN' (σ T : ℝ) : ℝ := zetaZeroesSum (Set.Ioo σ 1) (Set.Ioo 0 T) fun _ ↦ 1

noncomputable def zetaNClosed (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  zetaZeroesSum Set.univ (Set.Ioc 0 t) fun _ ↦ 1

noncomputable def rvmMain (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  t / (2 * π) * log (t / (2 * π)) - t / (2 * π) + 7 / 8
